fundamentals.name: Netflix, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.

judgment.summary: A high-growth, highly profitable company with strong cash flow, trading at a premium valuation.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter EPS was 1.23 vs estimate 1.25 (surprise -1.4%); next earnings date is 2026-07-16.
positives: Revenue growth 16.2% YoY and earnings growth 86.4% YoY indicate strong top and bottom-line expansion.
Operating margin of 32.3% and profit margin of 28.5% demonstrate excellent profitability.
Free cash flow of $25.99B TTM provides significant financial flexibility.
Return on equity at 48.5% shows efficient use of shareholder capital.
negatives: Forward P/E of 21.51 and PEG ratio of 1.61 suggest a premium valuation.
Total debt of $16.74B is higher than total cash of $12.29B.
Beta of 1.49 indicates higher volatility than the broader market.

news.paragraph: Netflix is being positioned as a top-tier blue-chip stock, with multiple articles discussing its potential to become a trillion-dollar company by 2030. However, one analysis suggests the stock needs a new narrative beyond AI to overcome underperformance. The company's last reported quarter saw a slight EPS miss, with the next earnings date set for July 16th.
